Live burden: The critique must identify a principled relevance threshold, compare the observed network against it, and explain why the system cannot constitute one limited stage even if it falls far short of cellularity. Locked score: The mixed band reflects genuine experimental relevance and partial contact with the pathway inference, offset by overstatement, incomplete responsiveness, comparatively weak warrant, and insufficiently charitable treatment of investigator-mediated experimentation.

corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The move supplies a concrete contrast between sequence-intensive engineered biological systems and a prepared salt system displaying templated, coupled catalytic organization, thereby advancing the claim that simple chemistry can generate nontrivial structure. Principal limitation: The asserted first occurrence outside biology and the inference from improbability are not independently supported here, while sodium molybdate selection and experimental preparation appropriately prevent any claim of wholly unaided environmental emergence. Live burden: The experiment must establish reproducibility, quantify structural improbability against relevant chemical baselines, and connect the coupled set to copying, variation, or selection without conflating surprising organization with life. Locked score: The strong or competent band reflects specific experimental content, productive qualification, central generative relevance, and meaningful partial responsiveness, tempered by unverified novelty, incomplete downstream continuity, and evidentiary dependence on asserted interpretation.
